description:
Create a scientific diagram of the MAPK/ERK signaling pathway in draw.io.

1. Open the starter file at '~/Diagrams/mapk_pathway.drawio' (it contains cellular compartments).
2. Read the requirements in '~/Desktop/pathway_requirements.txt'.
3. Add the 10 specified signaling molecules (EGF, EGFR, GRB2, SOS, RAS, RAF, MEK, ERK, ELK1, MYC) in their correct locations.
4. Connect them with directed arrows to show the signal flow.
5. Apply the color-coding scheme specified in the requirements.
6. Add a legend to the diagram.
7. Save the diagram.
8. Export the final image as a PNG to '~/Diagrams/exports/mapk_pathway.png'.

Note: If an update dialog appears on startup, dismiss it.
